news.title: As Anthropic suspends access to new models, India debates its AI future
news.description: Tech leaders debate whether the Anthropic episode is a wake-up call for India’s AI ambitions.

news.title: KPMG pulls report on AI usage due to apparent hallucinations
news.description: Once again, AI proves to be an unreliable source of information about AI.

news.title: Amazon CEO reportedly raised Anthropic model concerns before government crackdown
news.description: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy may have been the source of security concerns that led Anthropic to cut off worldwide access to two models on Friday.

news.title: OpenAI faces investigation from state attorneys general
news.description: It's not clear which states are involved, but they're asking about everything from OpenAI's ad policies to its handling of health data.

news.title: Kalshi to make some users reveal job details to tackle insider trading
news.description: After issues with insider trading, the prediction betting platform is adding new rules.

news.title: Version of AI tool 'too powerful for public' released to public
news.description: Claude Fable 5 is a version of Anthropic's Claude Mythos, an AI program which caused a stir among technology, finance, and government leaders.

news.title: A Court Has Ruled That Google Is Liable for False Statements Generated by AI Overviews
news.description: The ruling holds that a company that designs, trains, operates, and manages an AI system must assume legal liability for any damages caused by the responses it generates.
